arguments.command:
cd /tmp/epafiles || mkdir -p /tmp/epafiles && cd /tmp/epafiles
for yr in {2000..2010}; do
  zip="https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/daily_42101_${yr}.zip"
  file=daily_42101_${yr}.zip
  csv=daily_42101_${yr}.csv
  if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
    echo "Downloading $file"
    curl -s -O "$zip"
  fi
  if [ -f "$file" ] && [ ! -f "$csv" ]; then
    unzip -o "$file"
  fi
  # process csv
  if [ -f "$csv" ]; then
    echo "Processing $csv"
    awk -F"," 'BEGIN{OFS=FS}
    NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){h[$i]=i} next}
    {gsub(/"/,"","$0");}
    {cbsa=$1; date=$3; aqi=$8; if(aqi=="") next; key=cbsa"|"date; if(aqi>max[key]) max[key]=aqi}
    END{
      for(k in max) {
        split(k,arr,"|"); cbsa=arr[1]; date=arr[2]; if(max[k]>50) print cbsa","date","max="max[k]
      }
    }' "$csv" > "co_exceed_${yr}.csv"
  fi
done

# Now check for each year if any of our CBSAs have any exceedance
cbsa_list=("Portland-Vancouver-Hillsboro, OR-WA" "Wichita, KS" "San Diego-Carlsbad, CA")
for yr in {2000..2010}; do
  echo -n "$yr:"
  for cbsa in "${cbsa_list[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "co_exceed_${yr}.csv" ]; then
      grep -F "${cbsa}," co_exceed_${yr}.csv > /dev/null && echo -n " ${cbsa}!=GOOD" || echo -n " ${cbsa}=GOOD"
    else
      echo -n " ${cbsa}=NODATA"
    fi
  done
  echo
done
